blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **действи́тельность** — reality, actuality. Source: Wiktionary, «-ость» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ость#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**Действительность** — действи́тельность: reality, actuality; validity (of a document). Wiktionary: действи́тельный + -ость.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **реши́тельность** — resolution, resoluteness, decision. Source: Wiktionary, «-ость» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ость#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**решительности** — реши́тельность: resolution, resoluteness, decision. Wiktionary: реши́тельный + -ость.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **ча́стность** — particular. Source: Wiktionary, «-ость» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ость#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: The outside walls of the auditorium are terribly stained. It is, in part, due to acid rain.
exercises.ru: Наружная аудитория вся в пятнах. В ___, из-за кислотных дождей.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **нару́жность** — appearance, looks; exterior. Source: Wiktionary, «-ость» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ость#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: да́нность — a given; благода́рность — gratitude, gratefulness, thankfulness; ма́лость — smallness, trifle; мо́лодость — youth (state of being young).

exercises.q: Tom is a good-looking young man.
exercises.why: **наружности** — нару́жность: appearance, looks; exterior. Wiktionary: нару́жный + -ость.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **да́нность** — a given. Source: Wiktionary, «-ость» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ость#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: I take it for granted that I'm such a great pilot.
exercises.ru: Для меня это ___, что я прекрасный пилот.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **благодарности** — благода́рность: gratitude, gratefulness, thankfulness. Wiktionary: благода́рный + -ость.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.
